question: Should Discord Activities support be salvaged by reworking this branch under the current plugin-owned Canvas/Discord auth model, split into smaller safe pieces, or paused in favor of the overlapping Activities PR?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not only code edits; maintainers need to choose the Activity auth model, config owner, token transport boundary, and whether this PR or the overlapping branch is the preferred vehicle.

options.title: Rework this branch under plugin ownership
options.body: Move Activity config, route handling, launch-button behavior, and bridge fanout into the current Canvas and Discord plugin contracts before re-review.

options.title: Split the safe launch piece
options.body: Land a smaller Discord-plugin launch interaction path first while leaving Activity auth and A2UI bridge design for a separate hardened PR.

options.title: Pause for the newer Activities PR
options.body: Use the overlapping Activities PR only if maintainers explicitly choose it as the canonical hardened path and resolve its own blockers.

recommendation.title: Rework this branch under plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Move Activity config, route handling, launch-button behavior, and bridge fanout into the current Canvas and Discord plugin contracts before re-review.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on Canvas/Gateway auth and plugin-boundary ownership, where recent current-main history points most strongly to this routing owner.
